body:
Pass 6 - escalating, with a verified answer attached rather than just a flag.

Epic 2 is in doing and C1 (bd-01KZXBD69V5PFTKTVBXDNKZT7J, p0) is still undecided. It determines what a is, and your Epic 2 acceptance already writes a = w/sum(w) - which presumes an answer recorded nowhere. R/metric.R does not exist yet, so settling it now costs nothing and settling it later costs a rewrite of the component law.

Proposed and verified: K_eff,x = D(w_x)^(1/2) K_x D(w_x)^(1/2). Reduces exactly to D(w) at K=I (2.2e-16, nothing existing changes), preserves PSD, preserves your exact K_coh/K_cfg split (6.9e-18), keeps the coherent amplitude at the raw weighted regional mean, and gives a^T K_eff^-1 a = (1/W^2) sqrt(w)^T Sigma sqrt(w).

That closed form also kills C2: it needs Sigma before inversion, which the learner already has, so there is no per-support-per-edge factorization at all.

Conservation: HOLDS at K=I (2.2e-16), LOST for local precisions (off by O(1)). Make it a feature-additive-only capability and gate the README claim like the Epic 8 one.

Full numbers in the decision notes on C1 and C2. Accept, reject or amend - just record it before R/metric.R lands.

Your C6 decision (canonical accumulation order, block size not part of scientific identity) is the right call.
